sample_unit: AI-generated patient education paragraphs (7 diagnoses x 4 chatbots)

links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) and PEMAT understandability of chatbot patient education text
links.effect: Claude 2 FRE 67.0, FKGL 7.4, understandability 69%; ChatGPT FRE 58.5, FKGL 9.3, 69%; Bard FRE 50.1, FKGL 9.9, 52%; HuggingChat FRE 48.7, FKGL 11.6, 57%.
links.quote: Claude 2 and ChatGPT demonstrated superior readability and understandability, but practical application and patient outcomes need further exploration.

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of AI-generated patient education text
links.effect: FKGL 7.4 (Claude 2), 9.3 (ChatGPT), 9.9 (Bard), 11.6 (HuggingChat); most above a typical 6th-8th grade target.
links.quote: HuggingChat scores were FRE (48.7) and FKGL (11.6), PEMAT (57% and 29%).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT, Bard, Claude 2, HuggingChat) on readability and understandability (PEMAT) metrics for patient education paragraphs about common diagnoses without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
